svg.text: The deep-pipeline edition: 14 short stages, one place that stalls, one place that commits
src/deep/Riscv64_Deep.sv. Each stage does less, so the clock is shorter; every wrong guess and every wait now costs more stages (docs/DEEP_PIPELINE.md).
4 KiB, 2 ways; tags, LRU, refill, prefetch, predecode
F1 sends the index, F2 reads, F3 compares, F4 acts
emptied by reset or by fence.i at M1
read in F1, trained after M1
X4 finishes the address, M1 reads the arrays
a miss replays the load from M2
holds F1..D2 when an operand is late
M1 flush (wrong guess, JALR, trap, fence.i): F1..D2 refilled, X1..X4 dropped. The six-stage pipeline pays 3 of those bubbles; the rest are B
load miss: the load and everything younger are fetched again when the line is nearly in
Measured (ASAP7 7 nm-class, logic only, tools/timing.sh) and projected; wires and clock skew not included
